question: Does LoRA training of Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 (MLX 4bit) on verified SWE-smith-py Train tasks raise trusted pass rate on a repository-disjoint held-out set, versus the no-update policy, at identical inference budgets?

model.target_machine: Apple M1 Pro, 32 GB unified memory, about 11 GiB free disk

curriculum.split_rule: repository-disjoint; held-out repositories never contribute training, rollout, preflight or validation rows
curriculum.exclusions: huggingface/*, vllm-project/*, ml-explore/* and every repository named in VARE eval/Development identifiers (scan must find vllm-project/vllm#64830 and ml-explore/mlx-lm#1904); content dedup by normalized patch hash and (repo, file, issue-text hash)
curriculum.execution: native venv per repository at a pinned mirror commit; no containers
curriculum.calibration: on the run machine, before any inference: baseline (bug applied, no edit) must fail FAIL_TO_PASS and pass PASS_TO_PASS; reference fix must pass both; prompt must fit max_prompt_tokens. Non-qualifying tasks are dropped for every arm.
curriculum.contamination: UNKNOWN: upstream repositories are public and may be in pretraining data; the bug-introducing mutations are synthetic. Claims are relative (arm vs no-update on identical tasks).

arms.sft_reference: LoRA SFT on grader-verified reference-fix demonstrations of qualified Train tasks (dataset references, not student trajectories)
arms.rft_self: LoRA SFT on the base policy's own trusted-verified samples on Train tasks (rejection-sampling fine-tuning)
arms.grpo: not run in v1 (stub only; estimated 8-12 GiB peak, multi-turn loss would need custom code)

budgets.matched: sft_reference and rft_self share every training hyperparameter and iteration count; all arms share the held-out task set, prompt, decoding and max_tokens. rft_self additionally consumes the rollout budget (40 x 4 base samples); sft_reference uses privileged reference fixes. Both asymmetries are reported, not hidden.

measures: one greedy generation (tokens, seconds, peak memory)
LoRA peak memory and tokens/s at about 0.85 x max_seq_length

stopping_rules.disk_rule: checked before every task/sample/arm and against the preflight projection; stop if free disk is or would fall below the minimum
stopping_rules.rft_rule: below either minimum, rft_self is recorded NO_GO and not trained; the remaining comparison family shrinks accordingly
stopping_rules.hash_rule: any frozen input/code hash mismatch stops the run before any phase
stopping_rules.adapter_rule: a trained adapter with all-zero LoRA B matrices stops the run

success_criteria.primary_metric: per-task trusted_full_v1 pass, greedy, one sample, qualified held-out tasks
success_criteria.test: exact two-sided McNemar, Holm-adjusted over the family
success_criteria.improved: Holm p < alpha AND pass-rate lift >= min_absolute_lift AND arm-only wins > base-only wins
secondary: paired bootstrap 95% interval of pass-rate difference
success_criteria.power_note: with n=40, normal-approximation McNemar power is about 0.66 for discordant rates 0.20/0.025 and about 0.80 for 0.25/0.025 (single comparison, before Holm); smaller real effects will likely read as no_detectable_change

hypothesis_compatible_logging.budgeted_verifier_error_correction: every candidate records both verifier verdicts, their seconds and pytest exit/stdout hashes, so verifier false positives (cheap pass, trusted fail) and correction budgets can be replayed offline
hypothesis_compatible_logging.training_time_verification_allocation: rollout groups keep all samples with both verdicts and costs, so policies that spend trusted checks on a subset can be simulated against full-information labels before any new training run

files: rollouts/graded.jsonl (RFT data, base checkpoint, G=4 per task)
rollout_log.per_test_status: PASSED/FAILED/ERROR/SKIPPED/XFAIL/XPASS/MISSING/TIMEOUT for every requested F2P and P2P id; empty when the edit could not be applied (no tests run)
rollout_log.cheap_verifier_cost: cheap_f2p_v1 is a separate pytest run of only FAIL_TO_PASS, so its wall time is measured directly, not derived
rollout_log.checkpoint_scope: v1 RFT is single-round: every rollout comes from the base checkpoint (step 0). Rollouts from intermediate training checkpoints are not produced in v1.

memory_estimate_gib.formula: weights + 3 x seq x vocab x bytes (logits, grad, log-softmax) + checkpointed hidden states + one-layer recompute + LoRA/Adam + 0.75 GiB

synthetic_mock.label: mock outputs copy reference fixes; never evidence
